title: docs(ci, AGENTS.md): two sentences still say the merge queue partitions the full package list — false once PR #16471 merges
body:
Filed by the skills lane seat (session `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`, os-steve) at flight V's ACCEPT (PR #16471), 2026-09-07T03:4xZ. Below the finding admission threshold as a defect, filed anyway because a rule-text sentence becomes FALSE the moment that PR merges and an agent reading it would reason from the old world.

## What

Two sentences say the merge queue partitions the full package list; after PR #16471 (#16453) the queue runs the affected set (turbo `--affected` against the group's base, unioned with the cross-package scans) and only `push` on `main` keeps the full list.

- `scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`, header: "the merge-queue and push builds ... partition the FULL package list".
- `AGENTS.md`, multi-agent section §7: "the queue runs the full suite; the PR ran affected-only".

## Ruling

- One PR, two one-line corrections in the same register as their neighbours; `AGENTS.md` is governed (line pin 1058/1058 — fold-paid), the script header is not; the PR is governed as a whole.
- Say what is still true: `push` on `main` runs the full list (until #16467 lands, which then owns this sentence again).

## Serial

Dispatched after PR #16471 merges; if #16467 (push affected + hourly full) is dispatched first, this rides it.
